resources.string: Streaming only: time from dispatch to the first model event. SSE heartbeat comments do not reset it. The total budget also includes the local queue.
Applies to text providers, including chat, titles and compaction. Does not change tool timeouts. Cancelling a queued request prevents dispatch.
Time allowed to establish a connection: 5–120 seconds.
Maximum silence while waiting for headers, prefill or the next bytes. Recommended for long local contexts: 30 minutes.
Includes the local queue and generation. Compaction uses its own request budget below. A turn also has its budget in Termux settings.
Shared by all text providers: 1–8. For two vLLM replicas: 2. Waiting priority: continuation, required compaction, chat, background, title. Active requests are not interrupted.
